method: gap_bps = round((monday_price - friday_price) / friday_price * 10000, 2); friday_price = open of the 1-minute Dukascopy bar starting at Friday 16:00 ET (DST via IANA America/New_York, matching Treaty._isUsDst/fridayCloseOf); monday_price = open of the 1-minute bar starting at Monday 9:30 ET (matching Treaty.weekWindow's expiry, DST decided by Monday's own date)
